mode: Window-free egui harness and unit/lint checks only; no desktop, native-menu/window or preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: exclusive checked modes, preference persistence/restart, viewport reclamation, hover reveal, no document/history mutation, pressed/released coalesced gesture mapping at display scales 1 and 2 with repeated layout passes, text-preset popup retention, Studio isolation, short-display View menu scrolling

settings_unit.scope: old optional default, boolean validation and persisted true round trip

shared_action_tests.scope: existing action checks plus Classic-only toolbar availability, no-document support, blocked state, checked-state exclusivity and unique activation codes

limits: The screenshot establishes menu labels and choices, not runtime hover behavior. PaintCraft currently reclaims toolbar layout space, reveals on menu/toolbar hover and holds layout through pointer/focus/popup interaction; pinned Windows behavioral and native visual parity are unqualified. Thumbnail remains a disabled preview.
